_readme: Video-model behaviour and prices drift week to week. Every rule and model entry below was last checked on the date it carries; treat older entries as hypotheses and re-check against GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/videos/models (free, no key; prices are in pricing_skus) and a real paid probe for behaviour before a big run. est_usd_per_second feeds --dry-run and --max-usd only; the real cost of each clip is read from the API and written to its sidecar. Rules match shot fields: sing, face, framing, kind, audio_ref. First match wins; a shot's own 'model' beats every rule.

rules.reason: Sung close-ups and medium shots: keyframe plus the VOCAL-STEM slice as input_references. Audio-match 0.82-0.99 on eight close-ups at a fraction of Hailuo 3's price. It rejects a first_frame plus references, so the keyframe goes in as a reference (build_clips.py does this).
rules.note: OBSERVATION from one project (2026-10-14). It invents props near the mouth (a microphone, a gloved mic hand) unless the prompt says no microphone and keeps the hands out of frame.

rules.reason: Sung band wides and hero performance shots: Hailuo 3 with the FULL MIX as the audio reference, so hands and drums move to the music. Faces held far better than HeyGen Video 1 at this width.
rules.note: OBSERVATION. Non-singing band members still mouth along about half the time, even with 'mouth closed' per character; the keyframe's open mouths get copied. Crop them out in post if a retake does not fix it. 2K output only.

rules.reason: Band shots during an instrumental: an instruments-only stem mix as the audio reference plus 'nobody sings, all mouths stay closed' in the prompt. Hands and heads move to the music and nobody mouths words.
rules.note: OBSERVATION. Mouths open in the keyframe stay open for the first second or so; trim the head of the clip in the cut.

rules.reason: Silent emotional acting (fear, grief, a scream, a tear): Hailuo 3 Max at 480p acted better than Seedance 1.5 Pro in a head-to-head on the same chained frame, and took faces Seedance 2.5 refused.
rules.note: OBSERVATION. Pads its frames with a repeated frame about every 4th frame (judder): drop duplicates and re-interpolate (chain_join.py align --dedupe). One take jumped to a close-up mid-clip; say 'one continuous shot'.

rules.reason: Physical action and state changes (a yank, a slam, candles snuffed row by row, boots walking at floor level) and no-face shots that need real physics. Seedance 1.5 Pro failed these.
rules.note: OBSERVATION. Refused photoreal faces, including a photoreal creature, as 'may contain real person' (400, $0). Fall back to minimax/hailuo-3-max with a per-shot 'model' override.

heygen/heygen-video-1.label: HeyGen Video 1
heygen/heygen-video-1.price_note: listed $0.07/s at 480p with a reference (reference_duration_seconds_480p); actually billed $0.035/s at 480p on 2026-10-14. The estimate uses the listed price so --max-usd stays conservative. Checked 2026-10-14.
heygen/heygen-video-1.notes: Image and audio both go in input_references; a first_frame plus references is rejected. Passes the reference audio through into its soundtrack, so sync_offset.py can measure it. Video starts at pts ~0.083 s.

minimax/hailuo-3.label: Hailuo 3
minimax/hailuo-3.price_note: $0.13/s plus $0.04 per reference image; 2K output only (omit the resolution field). Checked 2026-10-14.
minimax/hailuo-3.notes: Audio-match 0.96-0.98 with a vocal or full-mix reference. Copies the keyframe faithfully, flaws included (a human hand on a werewolf, a gripped mic stand). Prompted camera sweeps on wides barely moved: do sweeps in post.

minimax/hailuo-3-max.label: Hailuo 3 Max
minimax/hailuo-3-max.notes: Best silent emotional acting found. Took photoreal faces Seedance 2.5 refused. One take changed a character's hair colour; check identity on the strip.

bytedance/seedance-1-5-pro.label: Seedance 1.5 Pro
bytedance/seedance-1-5-pro.price_note: token-priced; billed about $0.049 per 4 s at 480p and $0.105 per 4 s at 720p on 2026-10-14. Checked 2026-10-14.
bytedance/seedance-1-5-pro.notes: The cheap workhorse for silent shots and inserts; took every photoreal face in a 50-shot video. Weak at physics and state changes (it grew a giant candle for 'candles go out', giant boots for 'boots walk the aisle'). Text-to-video works for simple faceless inserts.

bytedance/seedance-2.5.label: Seedance 2.5
bytedance/seedance-2.5.price_note: token-priced; billed $0.08-0.10/s at 480p on 2026-10-14 ($0.415 per 5 s silent, $1.34 for 13 s). Checked 2026-10-14.
bytedance/seedance-2.5.notes: Strongest motion and physics. Refuses some photoreal faces, creatures included, per image. Audio works only when the keyframe is sent as input_references; a pinned first_frame silently drops it. Size words in an action prompt made a character double in size.

alibaba/wan-3.0.label: Wan 3.0
alibaba/wan-3.0.price_note: $0.05/s listed at 480p, about $0.042/s billed on 2026-10-14. Checked 2026-10-14.
alibaba/wan-3.0.notes: Not routed. Long multi-scene clips: cuts landed within 0.05 s of the beat, but only the first frame is pinned, so identity drifted after scene 1 and a body changed scale. If used: one scene set per request, about 13 s max.

x-ai/grok-imagine-video-1.5-lite.label: Grok Imagine 1.5 Lite
x-ai/grok-imagine-video-1.5-lite.price_note: $0.02/s at 480p plus $0.01 per input image. Checked 2026-10-14.
x-ai/grok-imagine-video-1.5-lite.notes: Not routed. Asked for a multi-scene clip it morphs between scenes instead of hard-cutting (max frame difference 8/255).

heygen/avatar-iv.label: HeyGen Avatar IV
heygen/avatar-iv.notes: Not routed. Exact audio passthrough (match 1.00) but a static talking head that reframes tight: rejected for performance shots.

kwaivgi/kling-v3.0-pro.label: Kling 3 Pro
kwaivgi/kling-v3.0-pro.notes: Held character identity well on 2026-10-10; rejects audio references. Good silent story shots.

google/veo-3.1-fast.label: Veo 3.1 Fast
google/veo-3.1-fast.price_note: $0.08/s at 720p without audio. Checked 2026-10-14 (price); behaviour last tested 2026-10-10.
google/veo-3.1-fast.notes: Drifted character identity in the 2026-10-10 test. Listed so the dry run can price it, not as a recommendation.
